name: Pixel Shader Fragment Clipping
definition: A voxelization method where the geometry shader rasterizes each triangle into all volume slices it intersects without clipping, and the pixel shader discards fragments based on their depth relative to slice boundaries.
summary: Pixel Shader Fragment Clipping is a single-pass GPU method that rasterizes triangles into all intersecting volume slices without clipping, relying on the pixel shader to discard out-of-bounds fragments.
